name: Guangshi Shuangmawei de Baoen
source:
"What do I look like?" On my way home from overtime, a dark figure suddenly appeared before me. Faced with the figure's question, and looking at the twintails on her head, longer than my arms, I fell silent...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3953050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“我看起来像什么？”在我加班回家的路上，一个黑色的人影突然出现在我的面前。面对人影的疑问，看着她头上比我手臂还要长的双马尾，我沉默了……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3953050/]Steam[/url]]
